query: what makes dirt good for growing crops

payload.answer: Dirt is considered good for growing crops because it acts as a living medium that supports plant growth and various organisms. Alluvial soil, which covers much of northern India, is very fertile due to its high proportion of potash, phosphoric acid, and lime [1]. Black soil is also excellent for agriculture because it holds moisture well and contains rich nutrients like calcium carbonate, magnesium, potash, and lime [2].
